chapter: Favorite bands, advice and family reflections
title: Al Grey, Don Byas and Onyx Club sessions
summary: He cannot place Al Grey and recalls playing jam sessions with Don Byas on 52nd Street.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: No, I don't remember any Al Grey.
that's a female band. didn't have much power.
The last time I played with him I had to play two sessions on Sunday afternoon. We played ... on 52nd Street. We were playing in the Oryx Club and he played with another band.
They had these jam session bands.
Who was in that band at that time.
No, the only thing is they say, come, you come to ... you sit down and they pick out who they want.
So, we were playing for the wedding. I think it was a wedding. And we were in the Oryx Club.
So, the manager asked me would I come down and play during intermission ...
